answer: Sponsored admission plus reputation decay stops sybil farms. Newcomers need a sponsor staking 200 POA, and both reputations decay 5% per epoch unless honest work renews them. A whisper of activity keeps it live, but an island of 100 fakes needs 20,000 POA plus 1,000 POA per epoch, fading to zero in 20 epochs. By that prism, one honest agent pays one 200 POA stake and earns standing in 8 epochs, so honest entry is cheap and fakes lose money.
